Les Parties s'engagent mutuellement à ne pas debaucher, directement ou indirectement, les salaries de l'autre Partie impliques dans l'execution du présent contrat, pendant sa duree et pendant une période de douze (12) mois suivant son expiration ou sa resiliation.

Le registre des activités de traitement prevu à l'article 30 du RGPD est tenu à jour par chaque entité du groupe et fait l'objet d'une consolidation annuelle par le DPO. Il recense 147 traitements de données personnelles au niveau du groupe.

La revue du dossier de fabrication a été effectuee par la Directrice Qualité & Certification (DOA/POA) prealablement à la libération du lot. Toutes les non-conformites identifiées ont été traitees et cloturees.

En cas de manquement par le Fournisseur a ses obligations en matière de delais de livraison, le Client pourra appliquer des penalites de retard d'un montant de 0,5% du prix de la commande concernee par semaine de retard, plafonnees a 10% du montant total de la commande.

La politique de classification des informations du groupe définit quatre niveaux : Public, Interne, Confidentiel, et Confidentiel Defense. Chaque niveau est associé à des mesures de protection spécifiques en matière de stockage, de transmission et d'accès.

Les Parties conviennent que toute modification du présent contrat devra faire l'objet d'un avenant écrit signe par les representants dument habilites de chacune des Parties. Aucune modification verbale ou tacite ne sera opposable.

El analisis del riesgo jurídico se ha realizado de conformidad con los principios de la NIC 37 relativa a provisiones, pasivos contingentes y activos contingentes. La probabilidad de materialización del riesgo se ha evaluado en tres niveles: probable, posible o remoto.

El analisis de tendencias de no conformidades de proveedores sobre los últimos 24 meses muestra un incremento significativo de las desviaciones dimensionales (+35%) en el proveedor Forges Martelliere, lo que requiere reforzar el plan de vigilancia.

El seguimiento del procedimiento sera asegurado por la Dirección Jurídica en coordinación con el despacho externo. Se presentara una actualización de avance al Comite de Auditoria en su proxima reunión trimestral.

El Proveedor garantiza que dispone de todas las autorizaciones, licencias y habilitaciones necesarias para el cumplimiento de sus obligaciones y se compromete a informar al Cliente sin demora de cualquier cambio que pueda afectar su capacidad de ejecucion.

La desviación dimensional constatada en la cota del puerto B (medida: 25,015 mm para una tolerancia de 25,000 +0,010/-0,000 mm) ha sido objeto de una solicitud de concesión tecnica a la oficina tecnica (referencia EC-2024-0089).

El mapa de riesgos de corrupción se ha actualizado conforme a las recomendaciones del Programa de Cumplimiento del Grupo y cubre la totalidad de los procesos de riesgo: compras, ventas internacionales, patrocinio y relaciones con agentes comerciales.

El plazo de prescripción de la accion es de cinco (5) anos desde la fecha del hecho generador, de conformidad con el artículo 1964 del Codigo Civil espanol. El plazo expira el 15 de marzo de 2028.

El expediente de lote incluye los registros siguientes: hoja de ruta, informes de ensayos (estanqueidad, fatiga, funcional, END), certificados de material, certificados de calibracion, fichas de desviacion en su caso, y certificado de liberacion EASA Form 1.

El presente contrato no podrá ser cedido, total o parcialmente, por ninguna de las Partes sin el consentimiento previo por escrito de la otra Parte. Cualquier cesión no autorizada será nula y sin efecto.

El importe de la provision se ha determinado sobre la base de la mejor estimación del desembolso necesario para cancelar la obligacion presente a la fecha de cierre, teniendo en cuenta los riesgos e incertidumbres inherentes al asunto.

Where subcontracting is authorized by the Customer, the Supplier shall remain solely responsible for the performance of all its contractual obligations. The Supplier shall ensure that subcontractors are bound by confidentiality and quality requirements no less stringent than those in this Agreement.

Statistical process control (SPC) monitoring is in place for critical dimensions identified in control plan CP-AV3000-Rev.F. Process capability indices Cpk exceed 1.67 for all key characteristics.

Packaging and labelling of all Products shall conform to the specifications set forth in the applicable Schedule. The Supplier shall be liable for any damage attributable to inadequate packaging during transport.

The Group's litigation history in comparable matters shows an amicable resolution rate of approximately 65%, with settlement amounts averaging 45% of the initial claim.

The Legal Department recommends appointment of a mediator accredited by the Centre for Effective Dispute Resolution (CEDR) to attempt settlement before the commencement of substantive proceedings.

This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, and agreements, whether written or oral.

Insurance coverage under the Group's professional indemnity policy has been verified. The applicable deductible is EUR 500,000 per claim, with an aggregate annual limit of EUR 50,000,000.

The batch record includes the following records: production traveller, test reports (leak, fatigue, functional, NDT), material certificates, calibration certificates, non-conformity reports where applicable, and EASA Form 1.

Storage conditions for released parts conform to requirements: temperature 15-25 degrees C, relative humidity below 60%, protection from dust and mechanical shock. Maximum storage duration before dispatch is 90 days.

The matter has been entered in the Group's legal risk register under reference LR-2024-XXX. Oversight has been assigned to the General Counsel.

The batch record review was completed by the Head of Quality and Airworthiness prior to lot release. All identified non-conformities have been dispositioned and closed.

The risk of an adverse costs order has been factored into the provision estimate, with additional exposure estimated at between GBP 50,000 and GBP 150,000.

The CAPA opened in response to the recurring non-conformity includes the following actions: supplementary supplier audit, enhanced receiving inspection, and qualification of an alternative supplier.

All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by registered mail, internationally recognized courier service, or email with read receipt confirmation, to the addresses set forth in the preamble.

Neither Party shall, during the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, directly or indirectly solicit or hire any employee of the other Party who was involved in the performance of this Agreement.

The dimensional deviation on port B bore (measured: 25.015 mm against tolerance of 25.000 +0.010/-0.000 mm) has been subject to an engineering concession request (ref. EC-2024-0089).

A conflict-of-interest check has been performed to ensure that the appointed external counsel does not represent any adverse party or have any relationship that could compromise the objectivity of their advice.

The provision amount has been determined based on the best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the present obligation at the reporting date, taking into account the risks and uncertainties inherent in the matter.

It is recommended that no public statement be made regarding this matter, given the confidentiality obligations under the mediation clause and the potential for reputational harm.

The Supplier shall procure and maintain throughout the Term professional liability insurance with a minimum cover of five million euros (EUR 5,000,000) per occurrence and in the aggregate per year, and shall provide evidence thereof upon request.

The Supplier shall procure and maintain throughout the Term professional liability insurance with a minimum cover of five million euros (EUR 5,000,000) per occurrence and in the aggregate per year, and shall provide evidence thereof upon request.

The Parties agree to hold quarterly performance review meetings to assess key performance indicators including quality metrics, on-time delivery rates, and corrective action effectiveness.

Pursuant to the Group's disclosure obligations, this matter must be reflected in the notes to the consolidated financial statements as a contingent liability, without specifying the provision amount to avoid prejudicing the Group's position.

In the event of late delivery, the Customer shall be entitled to liquidated damages of 0.5% of the relevant Purchase Order value per week of delay, capped at 10% of the total Purchase Order value.

The dimensional deviation on port B bore (measured: 25.015 mm against tolerance of 25.000 +0.010/-0.000 mm) has been subject to an engineering concession request (ref. EC-2024-0089).

Effectiveness verification of the corrective actions will be performed over the next three production lots. The CAPA will be closed after confirming no recurrence over a minimum of 150 parts.

The limitation period for the action is six (6) years from the date of the cause of action under the Limitation Act 1980 (England and Wales). The period expires on or about 15 March 2028.

The fatigue test was conducted per ASTM E466 at ambient temperature (23 +/- 2 degrees C), with a stress ratio R = 0.1 and a cyclic frequency of 10 Hz. The specimen endured 10^7 cycles without visible crack initiation.

The Supplier warrants that it holds all necessary authorizations, licenses, and permits required for the performance of its obligations. The Supplier shall promptly notify the Customer of any change that may affect its ability to perform.

The risk of an adverse costs order has been factored into the provision estimate, with additional exposure estimated at between GBP 50,000 and GBP 150,000.

A review of cross-indemnity provisions among Group entities has been initiated to determine which entity bears the ultimate financial burden of the litigation.

The batch record review was completed by the Head of Quality and Airworthiness prior to lot release. All identified non-conformities have been dispositioned and closed.

Part marking includes: lot number, part number, serial number, date of manufacture, and inspector stamp. Marking is performed by micro-percussion per customer specification.

It is noted that any document filed in the proceedings may be subject to disclosure to the opposing party. Internal documents should be prepared accordingly.

The tax treatment of the litigation provision has been reviewed by the Finance Department. The provision is tax-deductible subject to compliance with HMRC guidelines.

Certifie conforme a ISO 9001.

generation_archetype.label: Procurement, supplier risk, delivery, and solvency
generation_archetype.focus: supplier status, delivery risk, credits, receivables, contracts, guarantees, and exposure
perfect_guidance: Use supplier, contract, delivery, exposure, or credit facts that are explicitly stated.
Do not infer liquidation, full recovery, or offsets unless the evidence states them.
ambiguous_guidance: Use one supported supplier or exposure fact.
Pair it with one unresolved limitation about recovery, delivery continuity, guarantee coverage, or insolvency status.
wrong_guidance: Invent liquidation, guarantees, automatic offsets, delivery continuity, or total irrecoverability.
